headline: Tasmania Auditor-General Warns Infrastructure Mismanagement Poses Risk to Ports
summary: An auditor-general report warned that Tasmania's port infrastructure suffers from long-term poor management, creating severe operational risk and future cost burdens for the state.
why: Tasmanian ports facilitate bulk freight exports and supply lines between the island state and continental Australia.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Port infrastructure decay in Tasmania presents supply chain disruption risks.
